system.description:
Stout as stone and treacherous as a summer glacier. Jotunn hail from distant lands where they while away the winter dark with many competitions of prowess and cunning.

Challenger

+1 Might or Finesse. [M — add 1 point to the skill of your choice]

You ignore cold weather, and breathe comfortably in extreme altitudes. [M]

Advantage on skill checks when you engage in duels of wit, speed, strength or drinking. [M]

Nim+ Volume I — submitted by Santuric.
